workflow_runs.display_title: feat(tui): add Ctrl+Enter to backtrack with file undo

head_commit.message:
feat(tui): add Ctrl+Enter to backtrack with file undo

Add keybinding Ctrl+Enter in backtrack preview mode to rollback
conversation AND revert file changes using Op::Undo.

- Enter: rollback conversation only (existing behavior)
- Ctrl+Enter: rollback conversation + revert files (new)

Limitation: Currently only undoes the most recent ghost snapshot.
For multi-turn backtrack, earlier file changes may remain on disk.
A proper fix would require Op::UndoMultiple in the core protocol.

Closes #9344
